scope: Upstream observation-domain X research only; Y arrays copied unchanged; no serial-solver/physical-truth claim
baseline: Recorded calX, called V51_field_record by user deployment context; not a new exact online-state replay
prior_exploration: Both historical nights were already inspected in PR1 and signal analysis; parameters are separated by night, but this is not a blind final acceptance test

secondary_fold.purpose: fixed-recipe reverse stability check, not hyperparameter selection

alignment: nearest actual timestamp <=2000 ms; no interpolation
feature: trailing 5-minute median, minimum 3 real points; reset at gaps >90 seconds
reference_group: per-observing-device YJ channels, minimum 2 current valid references; response gains learned on fit night only

regression.type: zero-intercept standardized ridge on fit-night low-frequency target

A_YJ_guided: raw target X minus prediction from raw YJ group factors; YJ targets use global leave-one-physical-reference-out
B_YJ_residual_YXJ: recorded calX of YXJ only minus prediction from corrected YJ residual factors; amplitude limited by fit-night Q99 of fitted correction and Q99 of target residual; slew limited to 2x fit-night Q99 predicted step per minute
B_graph_scope: Only YJ groups at the observing-device and explicit MarkerData-bound-device endpoints; no invented geometry or remote fallback
candidate_gate: nominal 23:00-07:20 with 20-minute ramps; actual online gate not recorded
missing_reference_policy: fall back to recorded baseline, mark not_applied; no replacement with zero measurements
acceptance_reporting: Report every held-out YJ/YXJ channel, coverage, low-frequency drift, steps, cross-device agreement and regressions; do not select only favorable channels
injection: Known displacement-shape injections in observation coordinates; geometry missing, so these are not validated world-coordinate displacement projections
